title.zh: 授权总统代表菲律宾共和国政府为华盛顿特区进出口银行或任何其他国际银行为在伊利甘市设立综合钢厂提供的贷款提供担保并为其他目的
title.en: An Act Authorizing the President, for and in Behalf of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, to Guarantee Such Loans as May be Granted by the Export-Import Bank of Washington, D.C., or Any Other International Bank for the Establishment of an Integrated Steel Plant at Iligan City and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the President, for and in Behalf of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, to Guarantee Such Loans as May be Granted by the Export-Import Bank of Washington, D.C., or Any Other International Bank for the Establishment of an Integrated Steel Plant at Iligan City and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3519_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to guarantee absolutely or unconditionally, in the name and on behalf of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, the payment of the loan or loans that may be granted by the Export-Import Bank of Washington, D.C., or any other international bank, for the establishment, management and operation of an integrated steel mill at Iligan City, Philippines: Provided, However, That the amount of the guaranty undertaken shall not exceed the sum of two hundred seventy-five million pesos, Philippine currency.

The President of the Philippines is also hereby authorized to designate by appointment in writing such other person as he shall select to exercise any or all the powers conferred upon the President of the Philippines by this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1963.
